info.name: Restaurant - Auth APIs
info.description: Sign-up, login, JWT and role-based authorization. Run it first. Test users stay in the database (there is no delete-user API yet).

exec: pm.test("user created with the default USER role", () => { pm.expect(j.data.username).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newUsername")); pm.expect(j.data.roles).to.eql(["USER"]); pm.expect(j.data.age).to.eql(25); });
pm.test("username error", () => pm.expect(j.errors.username).to.eql("Username must contain at least 7 characters and not exceed 50"));
pm.test("password error", () => pm.expect(j.errors.password).to.eql("Password must contain at least 7 characters and not exceed 64"));

exec: pm.test("forbidden message", () => pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("You do not have permission to access this resource"));
pm.test("sender is stored on the message", () => { pm.expect(j.data.username).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newUsername")); pm.expect(j.data.userId).to.be.a("number"); });

item.name: 45a - USER can read his own messages

exec: pm.test("only his messages, including the new one", () => { pm.expect(j.data.content.every(c => c.username === pm.collectionVariables.get("newUsername"))).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.data.content.some(c => c.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("contactId")))).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 45b - ADMIN own list does not contain the USER message

exec: pm.test("no message of another user", () => pm.expect(j.data.content.every(c => c.username === pm.collectionVariables.get("adminUser"))).to.eql(true));

item.name: 46 - ADMIN can list contact information (the sender is shown)

exec: pm.test("the USER message shows its sender", () => { const m = j.data.content.find(c => c.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("contactId"))); pm.expect(m).to.not.eql(undefined); pm.expect(m.username).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newUsername")); });
